title: Binance hack: developing story
summary: The largest crypto theft on record: attackers drained Binance hot wallets on ten blockchains on Oct 29; part of the money has been frozen and Binance has paused all deposits and withdrawals and says it will cover the losses.

facts.label: Stolen
facts.note: Binance's own estimate of the impact (Reuters); TRM Labs US$6.36B at the time taken; Chainalysis at least US$5.9B

facts.label: Frozen so far
facts.note: Binance said verified frozen assets reached US$3B (00:52 UTC Oct 30); Tether over US$1.567B USDT, Circle over US$800M USDC, First Digital froze the FDUSD involved

facts.label: Still with the attacker
facts.note: beyond the reach of issuers, per TRM Labs (as of 00:30 UTC Oct 30)

facts.label: Recovered
facts.note: frozen funds have not been reported as returned

facts.label: When
facts.note: most of it within about 20 minutes

facts.label: Who
facts.note: not confirmed by Binance or any government yet

facts.label: Binance
facts.value: deposits and withdrawals suspended; says it will cover all losses
facts.note: Preliminary finding: a compromised engineer's laptop let an attacker submit unauthorized withdrawals; no evidence of a private-key leak (Binance via Cointelegraph, CoinDesk). Binance.US not affected.
